module id.desc: unique module name shown to the DroneEngage server and WebClient

unit type.desc: unit role. 'control_unit' marks this as a ground/control unit (enables static location broadcast). Any other value leaves the unit as a regular vehicle.

s2s udp listening ip.desc: local IP the module listens on for inter-module UDP (0.0.0.0 = all interfaces)

s2s udp listening port.desc: local port the module listens on for inter-module UDP

s2s udp packet size.desc: Sender-local UDP datagram payload size in bytes used to fragment outgoing messages. Does not need to match across modules; receivers accept any datagram up to 65507 bytes. Must be > 0 and < 65535. If omitted, auto-detect: 8192 for localhost, 1472 for remote (avoids IP fragmentation on standard Ethernet MTU).

use unix socket.desc: use a unix domain socket instead of UDP to talk to co-located modules (same-board communication only).

auth verify ssl.desc: verify the auth server SSL certificate. Default false.

root certificate path.desc: path to a root CA certificate. Used only when auth_verify_ssl is true and the certificate is internal/self-signed.

use local comm server.desc: connect to a local comm server instead of the main (auth-assigned) comm server. Requires local_comm_server_ip and local_comm_server_port to be set; otherwise falls back to the auth server.

local comm server ip.desc: local comm server IP. Used only when use_local_comm_server is true.

local comm server port.desc: local comm server port. Used only when use_local_comm_server is true.

userName.desc: DroneEngage account email used for authentication

accessCode.desc: account access code/password sent to the auth server

unit ID.desc: unique name identifying this unit on the server. Overridable by the local config file.

group ID.desc: group/channel this unit joins on the server

unit description.desc: human-readable description shown in the WebClient. Overridable by the local config file.

logger enabled.desc: enable file logging. Default false (logging disabled).

logger debug.desc: enable verbose/debug log output. Only meaningful when logger_enabled is true.

ping server rate (ms).desc: interval between keep-alive pings to the comm server, in milliseconds.

max allowed ping delay (ms).desc: max silence from the server before a reconnect is attempted, in milliseconds.

max offline count.desc: max failed reconnection attempts before the module aborts (so systemd can restart it). Default 5.

led pins enabled.desc: enable GPIO LED status indicators. Default true. Set false on boards without the LED wiring.

buzzer pins enabled.desc: enable GPIO buzzer notifications. Default true. Set false on boards without the buzzer wiring.

lng.desc: static longitude in E7 (degrees * 1e7). Used by control units to broadcast a fixed location.

lat.desc: static latitude in E7 (degrees * 1e7). Used by control units to broadcast a fixed location.

alt_abs.desc: static absolute altitude in mm (AMSL). Optional.

alt_rel.desc: static relative altitude in mm (above home). Optional.

location.desc: static location broadcast for control units. Values are in E7 (lat/lng) and mm (altitude). Only used when unit_type is control_unit. Omit the whole object (edit the config file) if no static location is desired.
